column2: One of the hills of Mecca
The fourth month of the year
Aunt of the Prophet; with long eyelashes
Mirage, shimmering air that looks like water from afar
Woman descended from a Turkish khan
Mother of Gülsüm; daughter of the Prophet Muhammad
Mole, with a mole; foster sister of the Prophet Muhammad
Where the sky meets the earth
Goddess of goodness who protects children
